info.description: Cached YouTube caption data keyed by youtubeVideoId. One row per YouTube video — shared across all Video rows that reference it. Immutable source data (rawSegments, duration, title, author) from youtubei.js.

rawText.description: Joined segment texts with no cleaning. Derivable from rawSegments — stored as a convenience for admin inspection and potential full-text search.

videoPublishedAt.description: YouTube's display text for the publish date, stored as strapi-plugin-youtube-transcripts stores it. Not a datetime.

searchIndex.description: Model-free BM25 index over rawSegments (makeStoredIndex from services/bm25-core.ts, no contextualizer). Built by fetchAndStore and lazily by readers.
